Subject: ArcOps vendor onboarding — vendor master information and PO process

Hi Amelia,

Thanks again for partnering with us. We're ready to set ArcOps up in our vendor master so finance can process POs and payments. To get the record created quickly, please send the following: 

- Legal entity name as registered with the IRS
- W-9 (or equivalent tax form for non-US entities)
- Registered business address and remit-to address (if different)
- Invoice remit instructions (email + portal or AP mailing address)
- Preferred payment method (ACH/wire/check) and bank routing details if you want ACH (we'll send a secure upload link)
- Primary billing contact name, email, and phone
- State/country tax registration numbers (if applicable)

I've attached our vendor_profile_template.xlsx to speed things up — fill the sheet and return it to me. A couple of notes on our side: Redwood issues POs for all vendor engagements over $2,500; payment terms by default are Net 30 unless negotiated on the SOW. Our finance team (cc'd) will validate the tax form and remittance details.

Could you get this back by Thursday so we can generate the vendor code and issue the initial PO?

Appreciate it,

--
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager

Priya / Laura —

Received the W-9 and filled profile from ArcOps. Quick checklist before we create the vendor record: 

- Verify EIN on W-9 against application (done)
- Confirm remit address (matches)
- Insurance certificate: ArcOps did not attach it. We typically require general liability for services > $25k — initial PO amount is $9,750 so insurance not blocking. I'll flag for the SOW owner to follow up.
- Banking details: ask them to upload full ACH details via our secure portal. Do NOT accept account numbers via email.
- PO process: Redwood PO format is RW-2026-{6 digits}, example RW-2026-004312. We can share a sample PDF with them.

Action plan: I'll create vendor record with status "Pending verification" and generate the initial PO as a draft. Laura — once vendor record exists, can you approve for payment terms Net 30?

--
Dev

Hi Amelia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9. We're good to proceed with the initial vendor setup. A few final items and confirmations: 

- Insurance: not required for this initial PO (amount < $25k). Your SOW owner can provide the certificate later if the engagement expands.
- Secure upload: Please use the link we emailed from our secure portal to submit full ACH details (we cannot accept full account numbers over regular email). If you need the link resent, let me know.
- PO format and sample: Your invoices should include our PO number in the heading. Example format we will issue: RW-2026-004312. I've attached Redwood_PO_guidelines.pdf with a sample PO and invoicing checklist.
- Payment terms: Net 30, payment will be made after invoice validation and receipt of goods/services.

We will create the vendor code today and issue the draft PO by end of day Monday. Expect the first PO and a vendor portal invite to arrive from procurement@redwood.com — please confirm when you receive the PO so we can close setup.

Thanks again — looking forward to working with ArcOps.

Best regards,
